protocol.scenario_source: routing_variant_bandit.make_case; synthetic cases on exported real geometry
protocol.starvation_metric: category-dimension cells never selected / all cells
protocol.category_mode_metric: fraction of category K weights equal to initial .5 at each checkpoint
protocol.evaluation: 50 held-out cases per checkpoint, frozen state; independent case/policy RNG streams; paired variants
protocol.uncertainty: sample SD and paired-seed percentile bootstrap 95% interval; descriptive, no multiplicity correction
protocol.recovery: first held-out checkpoint >=90% mean quality at 200 and 250; immediate post-shift probe; 50-decision resolution; unrecovered censored at 250
protocol.production_differences: prior bandit harness update +.02/-.005, no flip bonus or early halt; centroid scorer fallback, no live evidence

notes: Before shift, first floor(C/2) categories receive 80% probability, remaining categories 20%; after decision 250 those masses reverse. Uniform within each group. Evaluation follows the active distribution.
Production KUtilityStore is already category-indexed. SINGLE-K is a deliberately pooled ablation; REGIME-K matches production storage semantics.
No change to per-category evidence geometry; a category-frequency shift need not cause a quality drop. Recovery that is immediate is explicitly reported.

verdict.criterion: post-shift recovery >=30% faster on both copilots; zero-time control cannot establish recovery gain

preexisting_hash_discrepancy: investigation.py observed 3441dcbd before any writes; prompt expects 3441dcdb (last two characters transposed). Source preserved.

shared_harness_revision_audit.only_change: UCB bonus replaced by c*sigma/sqrt(N+1); this experiment has no UCB/adaptive arm, so its executed paths are unchanged.
